notes.title: Demo of our new game!
notes.content:
🐱 Hellbrella is a fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive!

notes.title: Eat Colors 2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mIPvr8QJ6jw;full][/previewyoutube]
Main changes in this update

 Now you can use a Controller to play instead of just the mouse
 Improved overall gameplay
 Lighting
 Art
 Level modifications
 More dynamic boss battles
 Soundtrack
 Eat Colors is now a free game

notes.title: Final Update
notes.content: Eat Colors will have its final on the 16/06 (Thursday), it will be a last update containing the 25 stages in the red world along with the end of your journey  to go to the colored apples :)

notes.title: Update Blue
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282600/4d2c7ae4ce7cdb7d7d78bba451422f082a97715e.png
What's New in the Update
Venture with the slime again in new levels in search of the Blue Apple in a scenario full of new challenges, mechanics and beautiful pixel art.

Phases in blue color
Added 25 stages
Scenario with a different theme from the first one
New mechanics
New challenges
Battle with Boss


Changes

I changed the general menus and the level selection HUD
I changed the way of telling the story from texts to Animations
The first stage had changes in cutscenes and in its design
At the end of level 25 there were changes in the cutscene
